spec_theorems.name: run_single_operand
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one operand, the utility emits that operand's computed directory result and succeeds.

spec_theorems.name: output_has_one_line
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one operand, successful dirname output consists of exactly one line.

spec_theorems.name: output_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one operand, the number of output lines is at most one.

spec_theorems.name: output_is_documented_parent
spec_theorems.informal: The emitted line is the pathname of the directory containing the final pathname component, as computed by the model.

spec_theorems.name: successful_exit_code
spec_theorems.informal: With exactly one operand, dirname terminates with exit status zero.

spec_theorems.name: stdin_is_ignored
spec_theorems.informal: The result for one operand is independent of the contents of standard input.
